label: GO, last few trials of the episode, after an unrewarded rare a1 trial (repeat a1)
explanation: Very sparse feature that fires only at GO, only in the episode final trials (all activations in ep_trials 90-99, concentrated at 95+), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew=0), and nearly always when the agent then chooses a1 (99.7% of mass; model_act=1, choice logit strongly positive). The typical context is a previous a1 trial that took the rare transition to S2 and went unrewarded, so the model-based response is to repeat a1. Most episodes in which it fires started with S2 good (start_high=0), and the value head is at its lowest bin, which is the end-of-episode value drop. Never fires at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, or before a2 choices. Predicate uses only observed history (ep_trial is position in the episode, which the GRU can only track internally). Dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.85. The ep_trial cutoff trades precision against recall (>=95: P 0.53/R 0.84; >=97: P 0.73/R 0.64). Misses are mostly weak activations after unrewarded common-a1 or a2 trials. Magnitude increases with ep_trial (top activations sit in the last 1-2 trials), consistent with an end-of-episode timing signal combined with an unrewarded-rare stay-on-a1 signal.
